def submission : Goal := by
  intro G _ h
  have e0 (X0 X1 X2 : G) : ((X0 ◇ X1) ◇ X2) = X1 := by
    exact (h X1 X0 X2).symm
  have e1 (X0 X1 X2 : G) : (X0 ◇ X1) = X2 := by
    exact (congrArg (fun q => (q ◇ X1)) (e0 X0 X0 X2)).symm.trans (e0 (X0 ◇ X0) X2 X1)
  have singleton : ∀ a b : G, a = b := by
    intro a b
    exact (e1 a a a).symm.trans (e1 a a b)
  intro x y z
  exact singleton _ _
